info.name: Visier Analytic Model Metrics V2 API
Retrieve a list of metrics by analytic object

params.name: analyticObjectName
params.description: The object name of the analytic object from which to retrieve metrics.

params.name: type
params.description:
The type of the metric to retrieve. Omit to retrieve all supported metric types. Valid values:
 - `simple`: Retrieves all simple metrics. A simple metric is a metric based on one or more analytic objects.
 - `derived`: Retrieves all derived metrics. A derived metric is a metric based on a simple metric.

params.name: with
params.description:
The level of information to retrieve for the metric. Valid values:
 - `basic`: Retrieves the metric's UUID, object name, and basic information. This is the default.
 - `details`: Retrieves the `basic` details and additional configurations, such as `visibleInAnalytics`.
 - `version`: Retrieves the object's version information, such as version type and last edited details.

params.name: objectName
params.description: The metric object names to return in the response. When combined with `uuid`, the results return objects that match either the `objectName` or `uuid`.

params.name: uuid
params.description: The metric UUIDs to return in the response. When combined with `objectName`, the results return objects that match either the `objectName` or `uuid`.

Retrieve a list of all simple or derived metrics in your Visier tenant. By default, the response will return the `basic` representation of the metric definitions.
**Note:** This API is in **alpha**. While in alpha, APIs may change in a breaking way without notice; functionality may be removed, and no deprecation notices will be issued. If you are interested in using this API, please contact your Customer Success Manager (CSM).

Create new simple or derived metrics. The response returns whether each metric was successfully created or not. When creating objects, assign a unique object name but don't set a UUID. Visier generates UUIDs for new objects.
